keySentence: Children see what adults often forget.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice's sister listened to her story. Children have special eyes. They see wonder and ask questions. Children see what adults often forget.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice's older sister listened carefully to every strange detail. She wished she could dream such wonderful dreams like Alice. Children see what adults often forget about the magical world. They ask why the sky is blue and where the stars go at dawn. Alice's adventure reminded her sister of her own childhood wonder. We should never stop seeing the world through curious young eyes.
facts.Word cards: see what = ~을 본다 / grown-ups = 어른들 / wonder = 경이로움 / notice = 알아채다
